title: Abelian complexity and synchronization
notes: arXiv:2011.00453. If an automatic sequence has bounded abelian complexity and the Parikh vectors of length-n prefixes are synchronized, Walnut constructs a DFAO for ρ^ab(n). The method is the effective literature competitor for the residual/signature gate: reproducing a complexity table that Walnut can already compute is not novelty.
